unicode: NFC recursively for string values and object keys
object_keys: Strings only; sort normalized keys lexicographically by Unicode code point; reject NFC collisions
arrays: Preserve element order and normalize recursively
numbers: Integers only; reject all floats, including NaN and infinities; do not coerce booleans to integers
whitespace: No insignificant whitespace; separators comma and colon
python_adapters: Tuples serialize as arrays; Enum values re-enter the same recursive validation

record_hash.input: Full supplied object, without implicit field omissions
record_hash.derivation: sha256: followed by lowercase hex SHA-256 of canonical_json_bytes(record)
record_hash.protocol_hash_projection: Existing ResponsibilityProtocol projection remains explicit; created_utc and protocol_hash remain excluded there only

scope: Python reference profile; not RFC 8785/JCS or proof of cross-language conformance, signature identity, external delivery or EFFECT_ACK_DONE
historical_hashes: No rewrite or implicit migration of native journals, terminal wire hashes, knowledge receipts or existing signed artifacts; each retains its own versioned encoding contract
